what: Soak contract metric does not match R3's. soak_state.py grades a Stage-1 leg 'ready' at 10 CLOSED TRADES, but R3 (RULE-R3-GATE1-COST-FIDELITY-v1) counts package-referenced fills per side (N_FLOOR=10). MEASURED 2026-10-04: 13 bybit_1 legs read ready in the live brief with 10 to 63 closes, yet R3 2026-09-25 grades 12 of them insufficient_n (ada_pullback_2h on 09-26: entry n=21, exit n=3). So 'ready' cannot be decided by the rule it names, and exit fills are mostly NOT package-referenced. Two fixes: (a) count what R3 counts in soak_state._count (package-referenced entry and exit fills); (b) root-cause why exits lack order_package refs, a data-provenance gap.
